scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && npm run test:python
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cardz/market-data && npm run build --workspace @cardz/web
scripts.verify:all: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:data && npm run images:verify && npm run build && npm run verify:public -- --allow-demo --require-build && npm run verify:deployment
scripts.verify:release: npm run audit:production && npm run images:verify:strict && npm run build:cloudflare && npm run verify:public -- --require-build && npm run verify:deployment
scripts.cf:dry-run:canary: npm run build:cloudflare && npm run verify:public -- --allow-demo --require-build && npm run verify:deployment && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run --env canary --config apps/web/wrangler.jsonc --outdir data/runtime/wrangler-canary
scripts.cf:deploy:canary: npm run build:cloudflare && npm run verify:public -- --allow-demo --require-build && npm run verify:deployment && npx wrangler deploy --env canary --config apps/web/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:dry-run:staging: npm run build:cloudflare && npm run verify:public -- --allow-demo --require-build && npm run verify:deployment && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run --env staging --config apps/web/wrangler.jsonc --outdir data/runtime/wrangler-staging
scripts.cf:deploy:staging: npm run build:cloudflare && npm run verify:public -- --allow-demo --require-build && npm run verify:deployment && npx wrangler deploy --env staging --config apps/web/wrangler.jsonc
